name: stockbit-mcp
description: IDX market data, bandarmology and your Stockbit account inside Claude Desktop. Unofficial.
long_description: The read-only half is one click: install, then say "log me into Stockbit" and sign in in the browser window that opens. Portfolio and order entry additionally need `stockbit-auth trading-login` (which asks for the PIN) and `stockbit-auth trading-enable --paper|--live` in a terminal — by design, so that nothing reachable from an assistant can turn trading on or handle a PIN.
